corpus.source_identity_rule: arXiv versionless identity is canonical; versioned assets are retained as provenance only when their checksum or declared revision is distinct.

native_route_corpus.source_identity_rule: Each row pins a repository-relative PDF by bare sha256 and its PDF-verified page count; a document's identity is its id plus that exact sha256, never the path alone. The three S02 corridor rows restate `corpus.documents` field-for-field; the nine holdout rows are already-committed arXiv identities whose PDF bytes and reference TEI exist in-tree.

selection.stratum_rule: An identity's stratum is its arXiv primary category mapped to the declared domains vocabulary: cs-* -> computer_science; math-* -> mathematics; cond-mat-*, physics-*, hep-*, quant-ph, astro-ph, gr-qc, nucl-* -> physics. Identities outside the closed domains vocabulary are ineligible.

native_route_threshold_reference.source_rule: Each route-corpus document id maps to exactly one reference TEI {path, sha256}. Holdout ids resolve to the acceptance-manifest measurable reference TEI for the matching article_id; corridor ids resolve to the preserved rich-profile TEI fixture `data/parse/regression_cases.yaml` binds. The block is not a second corpus: the document list stays authoritative in `native_route_corpus.documents`.

lanes.donor_identity_rule: Each lane receives the exact source_pdf and source_sha256 above; ordering is separate from extraction and every token remains conserved.

denominator.basis_note: The full assigned population is 610. 531 documents carry an admitted non-zero evaluated population at the frozen structural profile; the 79 typed exclusions stay inside the denominator. Every ratio below is therefore already band-scoped: document coverage of the assigned population is 531/610 = 0.870492.

refusal_semantics.definition: a refused document is an assigned identity whose bytes are present but which is neither in the probe's executed (per-document evaluated) population nor a typed exclusion; it stays inside the denominator
refusal_semantics.empty_reason: the frozen probe accounts for every one of the 610 assigned identities as executed or typed-excluded, so no document was refused and the refused set is explicitly empty

derivation.rule: assigned identities come from the holdout manifest; executed identities from the probe's per-document evaluated population (outcomes, matched by document_id); excluded identities from the probe's typed exceptions; a refused identity is assigned minus executed minus excluded; the projection is the document-id-sorted (document_id, disposition) list and the digest is sha256 over its compact UTF-8 JSON
derivation.projection_digest_rule: sha256 over json.dumps(projection, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) in UTF-8

population_census.boundary: consistency, not a tamper-evident attestation: a writer able to rewrite this block, the two frozen sources and the DATA rule can satisfy it; a scorecard that omits this block leaves the per-document half unverified while the aggregate partition stays governed by the domain's denominator and census checks

evidence.note: recomputed from evaluated_population.aggregate (admitted / source_population) and per-document conserved/source_population; the weakest document is recorded so the stratum is reproducible

micro recall is evaluated_population.class_parity.aggregate.native_capability_recall_micros / 1e6; the weakest family is the per-class conserved/source_population minimum across the 531 class profiles

measurements.reason_detail: production parses through java-grobid-http/0.9.1/processFulltextDocument at the structural profile; the native PDF-to-TEI route is not connected to a runner, so no java-free product measurement exists
no paired CPU measurement of the same workload exists; latency_accounting in the probe is bounded, not measured, and a wall-clock-only saving would not be a product measurement
the rollback pin is a rehearsed fallback target, not an executed product reliability measurement

authorization.note: D491 authorizes active non-commercial research only; it grants no release, distribution, graph write or import. The production retirement claim stays unmet until a named human records the release decision.

gate_run_history.note: M514-1lss2s/S01/T05 records the two governor architecture runs behind this baseline. The first run failed and its detailed output was not retained, so the cause is unresolved. A second run passed. A repeat is a fact, not a root cause.

runs.load: run alongside concurrent work; not a controlled serial run
serial re-run without concurrent cargo or python load

hypothesis.statement: the first failure may have been an environment-sensitive interaction in the da-parse test binary rather than a source regression; the bind-then-drop shape of http_backend_surfaces_transport_outage_as_unavailable is one candidate
hypothesis.evidence_from_the_failed_run: none: the gate printed only the last five stderr lines and did not record the failing test or its output
hypothesis.disconfirming_evidence: an isolated re-run of the same step and of backend_contract reported zero failures
cannot_conclude: no root cause is established
no claim that a flake was eliminated
no claim that no regression occurred

diagnostics_change.what: the architecture gate now persists the full stdout and stderr of every failing step and extracts the libtest failing-test names, so the next failure identifies itself

historical_guard_pins.note: sha256 of the M513 carriers this slice must not touch. Recomputed by scripts/tests/test_absorption_progress_baseline.py; a changed byte here is a finding, never a silent re-pin. Boundary: a writer able to rewrite both this ledger and the carriers can satisfy it.

without_path_identity.note: M513/S03 UAT-4 pins agree with every surface. Preserved as an identity; never re-run and republished as fresh evidence.

document.license: Derived scholarly TEI of public arXiv PDFs. Source papers remain under their arXiv licenses (typically CC BY / CC BY-SA / CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 as declared on each abstract page). GROBID TEI is candidate parse evidence, not a republication of the PDF. Do not treat these files as graph-importable.

reference_exception_reasons.detail: the frozen TEI header declares no author element, or every declared author name is rejected by the native personal-name parser (for example a single-token persName such as a group name), so no admitted author line exists and the native header composer refuses the document by assertion; a header without an admitted author cannot be measured by this lane

the frozen TEI header declares no dated element with text; the absence of a publication date is fatal both for this compact release probe and for the native header composer, so the document cannot be measured by this lane

the frozen TEI header's titleStmt declares a title element with no text (or whitespace only); an admitted title value of zero characters cannot be carried into XML character data, so the native header composer refuses the document by typed SemanticFieldLoss::HeaderTitle and this lane cannot measure it

selection.identity_rule: An asset's arXiv identity is the first name walking from the PDF stem up through its ancestor directories whose trailing version suffix (`vN`, N >= 1, no leading zero) is stripped and whose remainder matches `^\d{4}\.\d{4,5}$`; so `<cat>/<id>/source/original.pdf` inherits `<id>` and an `<id>vN` directory contributes revision N. When one identity has several assets the lowest revision wins (versionless counts as revision 0), then the lexicographically smallest repo-relative path breaks the remaining tie.

exclude.gold_identity_rule: file name with the trailing `.gold.json` removed

baseline_denominator.basis_note: The full assigned population is 610. 531 documents carry an admitted non-zero evaluated population at the frozen structural profile; the 79 typed exclusions stay inside the denominator. Every ratio below is therefore already band-scoped: document coverage of the assigned population is 531/610 = 0.870492.

corpus.source_identity_rule: arXiv versionless identity is canonical; versioned assets are retained as provenance only when their checksum or declared revision is distinct.

native_route_corpus.source_identity_rule: Each row pins a repository-relative PDF by bare sha256 and its PDF-verified page count; a document's identity is its id plus that exact sha256, never the path alone. The three S02 corridor rows restate `corpus.documents` field-for-field; the nine holdout rows are already-committed arXiv identities whose PDF bytes and reference TEI exist in-tree.

selection.stratum_rule: An identity's stratum is its arXiv primary category mapped to the declared domains vocabulary: cs-* -> computer_science; math-* -> mathematics; cond-mat-*, physics-*, hep-*, quant-ph, astro-ph, gr-qc, nucl-* -> physics. Identities outside the closed domains vocabulary are ineligible.

native_route_threshold_reference.source_rule: Each route-corpus document id maps to exactly one reference TEI {path, sha256}. Holdout ids resolve to the acceptance-manifest measurable reference TEI for the matching article_id; corridor ids resolve to the preserved rich-profile TEI fixture `data/parse/regression_cases.yaml` binds. The block is not a second corpus: the document list stays authoritative in `native_route_corpus.documents`.

lanes.donor_identity_rule: Each lane receives the exact source_pdf and source_sha256 above; ordering is separate from extraction and every token remains conserved.

denominator.basis_note: The full assigned population is 610. 531 documents carry an admitted non-zero evaluated population at the frozen structural profile; the 79 typed exclusions stay inside the denominator. Every ratio below is therefore already band-scoped: document coverage of the assigned population is 531/610 = 0.870492.

refusal_semantics.definition: a refused document is an assigned identity whose bytes are present but which is neither in the probe's executed (per-document evaluated) population nor a typed exclusion; it stays inside the denominator
refusal_semantics.empty_reason: the frozen probe accounts for every one of the 610 assigned identities as executed or typed-excluded, so no document was refused and the refused set is explicitly empty

derivation.rule: assigned identities come from the holdout manifest; executed identities from the probe's per-document evaluated population (outcomes, matched by document_id); excluded identities from the probe's typed exceptions; a refused identity is assigned minus executed minus excluded; the projection is the document-id-sorted (document_id, disposition) list and the digest is sha256 over its compact UTF-8 JSON
derivation.projection_digest_rule: sha256 over json.dumps(projection, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) in UTF-8

population_census.boundary: consistency, not a tamper-evident attestation: a writer able to rewrite this block, the two frozen sources and the DATA rule can satisfy it; a scorecard that omits this block leaves the per-document half unverified while the aggregate partition stays governed by the domain's denominator and census checks

evidence.note: recomputed from evaluated_population.aggregate (admitted / source_population) and per-document conserved/source_population; the weakest document is recorded so the stratum is reproducible

micro recall is evaluated_population.class_parity.aggregate.native_capability_recall_micros / 1e6; the weakest family is the per-class conserved/source_population minimum across the 531 class profiles

no paired CPU measurement of the same workload exists; latency_accounting in the probe is bounded, not measured, and a wall-clock-only saving would not be a product measurement
the rollback pin is a rehearsed fallback target, not an executed product reliability measurement

authorization.note: D491 authorizes active non-commercial research only; it grants no release, distribution, graph write or import. The production retirement claim stays unmet until a named human records the release decision.

gate_run_history.note: M514-1lss2s/S01/T05 records the two governor architecture runs behind this baseline. The first run failed and its detailed output was not retained, so the cause is unresolved. A second run passed. A repeat is a fact, not a root cause.

baseline_denominator.basis_note: The full assigned population is 610. 531 documents carry an admitted non-zero evaluated population at the frozen structural profile; the 79 typed exclusions stay inside the denominator. Every ratio below is therefore already band-scoped: document coverage of the assigned population is 531/610 = 0.870492.

corpus.source_identity_rule: arXiv versionless identity is canonical; versioned assets are retained as provenance only when their checksum or declared revision is distinct.

native_route_corpus.source_identity_rule: Each row pins a repository-relative PDF by bare sha256 and its PDF-verified page count; a document's identity is its id plus that exact sha256, never the path alone. The three S02 corridor rows restate `corpus.documents` field-for-field; the nine holdout rows are already-committed arXiv identities whose PDF bytes and reference TEI exist in-tree.

selection.stratum_rule: An identity's stratum is its arXiv primary category mapped to the declared domains vocabulary: cs-* -> computer_science; math-* -> mathematics; cond-mat-*, physics-*, hep-*, quant-ph, astro-ph, gr-qc, nucl-* -> physics. Identities outside the closed domains vocabulary are ineligible.

native_route_threshold_reference.source_rule: Each route-corpus document id maps to exactly one reference TEI {path, sha256}. Holdout ids resolve to the acceptance-manifest measurable reference TEI for the matching article_id; corridor ids resolve to the preserved rich-profile TEI fixture `data/parse/regression_cases.yaml` binds. The block is not a second corpus: the document list stays authoritative in `native_route_corpus.documents`.

lanes.donor_identity_rule: Each lane receives the exact source_pdf and source_sha256 above; ordering is separate from extraction and every token remains conserved.

denominator.basis_note: The full assigned population is 610. 531 documents carry an admitted non-zero evaluated population at the frozen structural profile; the 79 typed exclusions stay inside the denominator. Every ratio below is therefore already band-scoped: document coverage of the assigned population is 531/610 = 0.870492.

refusal_semantics.definition: a refused document is an assigned identity whose bytes are present but which is neither in the probe's executed (per-document evaluated) population nor a typed exclusion; it stays inside the denominator
refusal_semantics.empty_reason: the frozen probe accounts for every one of the 610 assigned identities as executed or typed-excluded, so no document was refused and the refused set is explicitly empty

derivation.rule: assigned identities come from the holdout manifest; executed identities from the probe's per-document evaluated population (outcomes, matched by document_id); excluded identities from the probe's typed exceptions; a refused identity is assigned minus executed minus excluded; the projection is the document-id-sorted (document_id, disposition) list and the digest is sha256 over its compact UTF-8 JSON
derivation.projection_digest_rule: sha256 over json.dumps(projection, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) in UTF-8

population_census.boundary: consistency, not a tamper-evident attestation: a writer able to rewrite this block, the two frozen sources and the DATA rule can satisfy it; a scorecard that omits this block leaves the per-document half unverified while the aggregate partition stays governed by the domain's denominator and census checks

evidence.note: recomputed from evaluated_population.aggregate (admitted / source_population) and per-document conserved/source_population; the weakest document is recorded so the stratum is reproducible

micro recall is evaluated_population.class_parity.aggregate.native_capability_recall_micros / 1e6; the weakest family is the per-class conserved/source_population minimum across the 531 class profiles

measurements.reason_detail: production parses through java-grobid-http/0.9.1/processFulltextDocument at the structural profile; the native PDF-to-TEI route is not connected to a runner, so no java-free product measurement exists
no paired CPU measurement of the same workload exists; latency_accounting in the probe is bounded, not measured, and a wall-clock-only saving would not be a product measurement
the rollback pin is a rehearsed fallback target, not an executed product reliability measurement

authorization.note: D491 authorizes active non-commercial research only; it grants no release, distribution, graph write or import. The production retirement claim stays unmet until a named human records the release decision.

gate_run_history.note: M514-1lss2s/S01/T05 records the two governor architecture runs behind this baseline. The first run failed and its detailed output was not retained, so the cause is unresolved. A second run passed. A repeat is a fact, not a root cause.

runs.load: run alongside concurrent work; not a controlled serial run
serial re-run without concurrent cargo or python load

hypothesis.statement: the first failure may have been an environment-sensitive interaction in the da-parse test binary rather than a source regression; the bind-then-drop shape of http_backend_surfaces_transport_outage_as_unavailable is one candidate
hypothesis.evidence_from_the_failed_run: none: the gate printed only the last five stderr lines and did not record the failing test or its output
hypothesis.disconfirming_evidence: an isolated re-run of the same step and of backend_contract reported zero failures
cannot_conclude: no root cause is established
no claim that a flake was eliminated
no claim that no regression occurred

diagnostics_change.what: the architecture gate now persists the full stdout and stderr of every failing step and extracts the libtest failing-test names, so the next failure identifies itself

historical_guard_pins.note: sha256 of the M513 carriers this slice must not touch. Recomputed by scripts/tests/test_absorption_progress_baseline.py; a changed byte here is a finding, never a silent re-pin. Boundary: a writer able to rewrite both this ledger and the carriers can satisfy it.

without_path_identity.note: M513/S03 UAT-4 pins agree with every surface. Preserved as an identity; never re-run and republished as fresh evidence.

document.license: Derived scholarly TEI of public arXiv PDFs. Source papers remain under their arXiv licenses (typically CC BY / CC BY-SA / CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 as declared on each abstract page). GROBID TEI is candidate parse evidence, not a republication of the PDF. Do not treat these files as graph-importable.

reference_exception_reasons.detail: the frozen TEI header declares no author element, or every declared author name is rejected by the native personal-name parser (for example a single-token persName such as a group name), so no admitted author line exists and the native header composer refuses the document by assertion; a header without an admitted author cannot be measured by this lane

the frozen TEI header declares no dated element with text; the absence of a publication date is fatal both for this compact release probe and for the native header composer, so the document cannot be measured by this lane

the frozen TEI header's titleStmt declares a title element with no text (or whitespace only); an admitted title value of zero characters cannot be carried into XML character data, so the native header composer refuses the document by typed SemanticFieldLoss::HeaderTitle and this lane cannot measure it

selection.identity_rule: An asset's arXiv identity is the first name walking from the PDF stem up through its ancestor directories whose trailing version suffix (`vN`, N >= 1, no leading zero) is stripped and whose remainder matches `^\d{4}\.\d{4,5}$`; so `<cat>/<id>/source/original.pdf` inherits `<id>` and an `<id>vN` directory contributes revision N. When one identity has several assets the lowest revision wins (versionless counts as revision 0), then the lexicographically smallest repo-relative path breaks the remaining tie.

baseline_denominator.basis_note: The full assigned population is 610. 531 documents carry an admitted non-zero evaluated population at the frozen structural profile; the 79 typed exclusions stay inside the denominator. Every ratio below is therefore already band-scoped: document coverage of the assigned population is 531/610 = 0.870492.

corpus.source_identity_rule: arXiv versionless identity is canonical; versioned assets are retained as provenance only when their checksum or declared revision is distinct.

native_route_corpus.source_identity_rule: Each row pins a repository-relative PDF by bare sha256 and its PDF-verified page count; a document's identity is its id plus that exact sha256, never the path alone. The three S02 corridor rows restate `corpus.documents` field-for-field; the nine holdout rows are already-committed arXiv identities whose PDF bytes and reference TEI exist in-tree.

selection.stratum_rule: An identity's stratum is its arXiv primary category mapped to the declared domains vocabulary: cs-* -> computer_science; math-* -> mathematics; cond-mat-*, physics-*, hep-*, quant-ph, astro-ph, gr-qc, nucl-* -> physics. Identities outside the closed domains vocabulary are ineligible.

native_route_threshold_reference.source_rule: Each route-corpus document id maps to exactly one reference TEI {path, sha256}. Holdout ids resolve to the acceptance-manifest measurable reference TEI for the matching article_id; corridor ids resolve to the preserved rich-profile TEI fixture `data/parse/regression_cases.yaml` binds. The block is not a second corpus: the document list stays authoritative in `native_route_corpus.documents`.

lanes.donor_identity_rule: Each lane receives the exact source_pdf and source_sha256 above; ordering is separate from extraction and every token remains conserved.

denominator.basis_note: The full assigned population is 610. 531 documents carry an admitted non-zero evaluated population at the frozen structural profile; the 79 typed exclusions stay inside the denominator. Every ratio below is therefore already band-scoped: document coverage of the assigned population is 531/610 = 0.870492.

refusal_semantics.definition: a refused document is an assigned identity whose bytes are present but which is neither in the probe's executed (per-document evaluated) population nor a typed exclusion; it stays inside the denominator
refusal_semantics.empty_reason: the frozen probe accounts for every one of the 610 assigned identities as executed or typed-excluded, so no document was refused and the refused set is explicitly empty

derivation.rule: assigned identities come from the holdout manifest; executed identities from the probe's per-document evaluated population (outcomes, matched by document_id); excluded identities from the probe's typed exceptions; a refused identity is assigned minus executed minus excluded; the projection is the document-id-sorted (document_id, disposition) list and the digest is sha256 over its compact UTF-8 JSON
derivation.projection_digest_rule: sha256 over json.dumps(projection, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) in UTF-8

population_census.boundary: consistency, not a tamper-evident attestation: a writer able to rewrite this block, the two frozen sources and the DATA rule can satisfy it; a scorecard that omits this block leaves the per-document half unverified while the aggregate partition stays governed by the domain's denominator and census checks

evidence.note: recomputed from evaluated_population.aggregate (admitted / source_population) and per-document conserved/source_population; the weakest document is recorded so the stratum is reproducible

micro recall is evaluated_population.class_parity.aggregate.native_capability_recall_micros / 1e6; the weakest family is the per-class conserved/source_population minimum across the 531 class profiles

authorization.note: D491 authorizes active non-commercial research only; it grants no release, distribution, graph write or import. The production retirement claim stays unmet until a named human records the release decision.

gate_run_history.note: M514-1lss2s/S01/T05 records the two governor architecture runs behind this baseline. The first run failed and its detailed output was not retained, so the cause is unresolved. A second run passed. A repeat is a fact, not a root cause.

baseline_denominator.basis_note: The full assigned population is 610. 531 documents carry an admitted non-zero evaluated population at the frozen structural profile; the 79 typed exclusions stay inside the denominator. Every ratio below is therefore already band-scoped: document coverage of the assigned population is 531/610 = 0.870492.

corpus.source_identity_rule: arXiv versionless identity is canonical; versioned assets are retained as provenance only when their checksum or declared revision is distinct.

native_route_corpus.source_identity_rule: Each row pins a repository-relative PDF by bare sha256 and its PDF-verified page count; a document's identity is its id plus that exact sha256, never the path alone. The three S02 corridor rows restate `corpus.documents` field-for-field; the nine holdout rows are already-committed arXiv identities whose PDF bytes and reference TEI exist in-tree.

selection.stratum_rule: An identity's stratum is its arXiv primary category mapped to the declared domains vocabulary: cs-* -> computer_science; math-* -> mathematics; cond-mat-*, physics-*, hep-*, quant-ph, astro-ph, gr-qc, nucl-* -> physics. Identities outside the closed domains vocabulary are ineligible.

native_route_threshold_reference.source_rule: Each route-corpus document id maps to exactly one reference TEI {path, sha256}. Holdout ids resolve to the acceptance-manifest measurable reference TEI for the matching article_id; corridor ids resolve to the preserved rich-profile TEI fixture `data/parse/regression_cases.yaml` binds. The block is not a second corpus: the document list stays authoritative in `native_route_corpus.documents`.

lanes.donor_identity_rule: Each lane receives the exact source_pdf and source_sha256 above; ordering is separate from extraction and every token remains conserved.

denominator.basis_note: The full assigned population is 610. 531 documents carry an admitted non-zero evaluated population at the frozen structural profile; the 79 typed exclusions stay inside the denominator. Every ratio below is therefore already band-scoped: document coverage of the assigned population is 531/610 = 0.870492.

refusal_semantics.definition: a refused document is an assigned identity whose bytes are present but which is neither in the probe's executed (per-document evaluated) population nor a typed exclusion; it stays inside the denominator
refusal_semantics.empty_reason: the frozen probe accounts for every one of the 610 assigned identities as executed or typed-excluded, so no document was refused and the refused set is explicitly empty

derivation.rule: assigned identities come from the holdout manifest; executed identities from the probe's per-document evaluated population (outcomes, matched by document_id); excluded identities from the probe's typed exceptions; a refused identity is assigned minus executed minus excluded; the projection is the document-id-sorted (document_id, disposition) list and the digest is sha256 over its compact UTF-8 JSON
derivation.projection_digest_rule: sha256 over json.dumps(projection, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) in UTF-8

population_census.boundary: consistency, not a tamper-evident attestation: a writer able to rewrite this block, the two frozen sources and the DATA rule can satisfy it; a scorecard that omits this block leaves the per-document half unverified while the aggregate partition stays governed by the domain's denominator and census checks

evidence.note: recomputed from evaluated_population.aggregate (admitted / source_population) and per-document conserved/source_population; the weakest document is recorded so the stratum is reproducible

micro recall is evaluated_population.class_parity.aggregate.native_capability_recall_micros / 1e6; the weakest family is the per-class conserved/source_population minimum across the 531 class profiles

measurements.reason_detail: production parses through java-grobid-http/0.9.1/processFulltextDocument at the structural profile; the native PDF-to-TEI route is not connected to a runner, so no java-free product measurement exists
no paired CPU measurement of the same workload exists; latency_accounting in the probe is bounded, not measured, and a wall-clock-only saving would not be a product measurement
the rollback pin is a rehearsed fallback target, not an executed product reliability measurement

authorization.note: D491 authorizes active non-commercial research only; it grants no release, distribution, graph write or import. The production retirement claim stays unmet until a named human records the release decision.

gate_run_history.note: M514-1lss2s/S01/T05 records the two governor architecture runs behind this baseline. The first run failed and its detailed output was not retained, so the cause is unresolved. A second run passed. A repeat is a fact, not a root cause.

runs.load: run alongside concurrent work; not a controlled serial run
serial re-run without concurrent cargo or python load

hypothesis.statement: the first failure may have been an environment-sensitive interaction in the da-parse test binary rather than a source regression; the bind-then-drop shape of http_backend_surfaces_transport_outage_as_unavailable is one candidate
hypothesis.evidence_from_the_failed_run: none: the gate printed only the last five stderr lines and did not record the failing test or its output
hypothesis.disconfirming_evidence: an isolated re-run of the same step and of backend_contract reported zero failures
cannot_conclude: no root cause is established
no claim that a flake was eliminated
no claim that no regression occurred

diagnostics_change.what: the architecture gate now persists the full stdout and stderr of every failing step and extracts the libtest failing-test names, so the next failure identifies itself

historical_guard_pins.note: sha256 of the M513 carriers this slice must not touch. Recomputed by scripts/tests/test_absorption_progress_baseline.py; a changed byte here is a finding, never a silent re-pin. Boundary: a writer able to rewrite both this ledger and the carriers can satisfy it.

without_path_identity.note: M513/S03 UAT-4 pins agree with every surface. Preserved as an identity; never re-run and republished as fresh evidence.

document.license: Derived scholarly TEI of public arXiv PDFs. Source papers remain under their arXiv licenses (typically CC BY / CC BY-SA / CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 as declared on each abstract page). GROBID TEI is candidate parse evidence, not a republication of the PDF. Do not treat these files as graph-importable.

selection.identity_rule: An asset's arXiv identity is the first name walking from the PDF stem up through its ancestor directories whose trailing version suffix (`vN`, N >= 1, no leading zero) is stripped and whose remainder matches `^\d{4}\.\d{4,5}$`; so `<cat>/<id>/source/original.pdf` inherits `<id>` and an `<id>vN` directory contributes revision N. When one identity has several assets the lowest revision wins (versionless counts as revision 0), then the lexicographically smallest repo-relative path breaks the remaining tie.

corpus.source_identity_rule: arXiv versionless identity is canonical; versioned assets are retained as provenance only when their checksum or declared revision is distinct.

native_route_corpus.source_identity_rule: Each row pins a repository-relative PDF by bare sha256 and its PDF-verified page count; a document's identity is its id plus that exact sha256, never the path alone. The three S02 corridor rows restate `corpus.documents` field-for-field; the nine holdout rows are already-committed arXiv identities whose PDF bytes and reference TEI exist in-tree.

selection.stratum_rule: An identity's stratum is its arXiv primary category mapped to the declared domains vocabulary: cs-* -> computer_science; math-* -> mathematics; cond-mat-*, physics-*, hep-*, quant-ph, astro-ph, gr-qc, nucl-* -> physics. Identities outside the closed domains vocabulary are ineligible.

native_route_threshold_reference.source_rule: Each route-corpus document id maps to exactly one reference TEI {path, sha256}. Holdout ids resolve to the acceptance-manifest measurable reference TEI for the matching article_id; corridor ids resolve to the preserved rich-profile TEI fixture `data/parse/regression_cases.yaml` binds. The block is not a second corpus: the document list stays authoritative in `native_route_corpus.documents`.

lanes.donor_identity_rule: Each lane receives the exact source_pdf and source_sha256 above; ordering is separate from extraction and every token remains conserved.

refusal_semantics.definition: a refused document is an assigned identity whose bytes are present but which is neither in the probe's executed (per-document evaluated) population nor a typed exclusion; it stays inside the denominator
refusal_semantics.empty_reason: the frozen probe accounts for every one of the 610 assigned identities as executed or typed-excluded, so no document was refused and the refused set is explicitly empty

derivation.rule: assigned identities come from the holdout manifest; executed identities from the probe's per-document evaluated population (outcomes, matched by document_id); excluded identities from the probe's typed exceptions; a refused identity is assigned minus executed minus excluded; the projection is the document-id-sorted (document_id, disposition) list and the digest is sha256 over its compact UTF-8 JSON
derivation.projection_digest_rule: sha256 over json.dumps(projection, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) in UTF-8

population_census.boundary: consistency, not a tamper-evident attestation: a writer able to rewrite this block, the two frozen sources and the DATA rule can satisfy it; a scorecard that omits this block leaves the per-document half unverified while the aggregate partition stays governed by the domain's denominator and census checks

evidence.note: recomputed from evaluated_population.aggregate (admitted / source_population) and per-document conserved/source_population; the weakest document is recorded so the stratum is reproducible

baseline_denominator.basis_note: The full assigned population is 610. 531 documents carry an admitted non-zero evaluated population at the frozen structural profile; the 79 typed exclusions stay inside the denominator. Every ratio below is therefore already band-scoped: document coverage of the assigned population is 531/610 = 0.870492.

corpus.source_identity_rule: arXiv versionless identity is canonical; versioned assets are retained as provenance only when their checksum or declared revision is distinct.

native_route_corpus.source_identity_rule: Each row pins a repository-relative PDF by bare sha256 and its PDF-verified page count; a document's identity is its id plus that exact sha256, never the path alone. The three S02 corridor rows restate `corpus.documents` field-for-field; the nine holdout rows are already-committed arXiv identities whose PDF bytes and reference TEI exist in-tree.

selection.stratum_rule: An identity's stratum is its arXiv primary category mapped to the declared domains vocabulary: cs-* -> computer_science; math-* -> mathematics; cond-mat-*, physics-*, hep-*, quant-ph, astro-ph, gr-qc, nucl-* -> physics. Identities outside the closed domains vocabulary are ineligible.

native_route_threshold_reference.source_rule: Each route-corpus document id maps to exactly one reference TEI {path, sha256}. Holdout ids resolve to the acceptance-manifest measurable reference TEI for the matching article_id; corridor ids resolve to the preserved rich-profile TEI fixture `data/parse/regression_cases.yaml` binds. The block is not a second corpus: the document list stays authoritative in `native_route_corpus.documents`.

lanes.donor_identity_rule: Each lane receives the exact source_pdf and source_sha256 above; ordering is separate from extraction and every token remains conserved.

denominator.basis_note: The full assigned population is 610. 531 documents carry an admitted non-zero evaluated population at the frozen structural profile; the 79 typed exclusions stay inside the denominator. Every ratio below is therefore already band-scoped: document coverage of the assigned population is 531/610 = 0.870492.

refusal_semantics.definition: a refused document is an assigned identity whose bytes are present but which is neither in the probe's executed (per-document evaluated) population nor a typed exclusion; it stays inside the denominator
refusal_semantics.empty_reason: the frozen probe accounts for every one of the 610 assigned identities as executed or typed-excluded, so no document was refused and the refused set is explicitly empty

derivation.rule: assigned identities come from the holdout manifest; executed identities from the probe's per-document evaluated population (outcomes, matched by document_id); excluded identities from the probe's typed exceptions; a refused identity is assigned minus executed minus excluded; the projection is the document-id-sorted (document_id, disposition) list and the digest is sha256 over its compact UTF-8 JSON
derivation.projection_digest_rule: sha256 over json.dumps(projection, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) in UTF-8

population_census.boundary: consistency, not a tamper-evident attestation: a writer able to rewrite this block, the two frozen sources and the DATA rule can satisfy it; a scorecard that omits this block leaves the per-document half unverified while the aggregate partition stays governed by the domain's denominator and census checks

evidence.note: recomputed from evaluated_population.aggregate (admitted / source_population) and per-document conserved/source_population; the weakest document is recorded so the stratum is reproducible

micro recall is evaluated_population.class_parity.aggregate.native_capability_recall_micros / 1e6; the weakest family is the per-class conserved/source_population minimum across the 531 class profiles

measurements.reason_detail: production parses through java-grobid-http/0.9.1/processFulltextDocument at the structural profile; the native PDF-to-TEI route is not connected to a runner, so no java-free product measurement exists
no paired CPU measurement of the same workload exists; latency_accounting in the probe is bounded, not measured, and a wall-clock-only saving would not be a product measurement
the rollback pin is a rehearsed fallback target, not an executed product reliability measurement

authorization.note: D491 authorizes active non-commercial research only; it grants no release, distribution, graph write or import. The production retirement claim stays unmet until a named human records the release decision.

gate_run_history.note: M514-1lss2s/S01/T05 records the two governor architecture runs behind this baseline. The first run failed and its detailed output was not retained, so the cause is unresolved. A second run passed. A repeat is a fact, not a root cause.

runs.load: run alongside concurrent work; not a controlled serial run
serial re-run without concurrent cargo or python load

hypothesis.statement: the first failure may have been an environment-sensitive interaction in the da-parse test binary rather than a source regression; the bind-then-drop shape of http_backend_surfaces_transport_outage_as_unavailable is one candidate
hypothesis.evidence_from_the_failed_run: none: the gate printed only the last five stderr lines and did not record the failing test or its output
hypothesis.disconfirming_evidence: an isolated re-run of the same step and of backend_contract reported zero failures
cannot_conclude: no root cause is established
no claim that a flake was eliminated
no claim that no regression occurred

diagnostics_change.what: the architecture gate now persists the full stdout and stderr of every failing step and extracts the libtest failing-test names, so the next failure identifies itself

historical_guard_pins.note: sha256 of the M513 carriers this slice must not touch. Recomputed by scripts/tests/test_absorption_progress_baseline.py; a changed byte here is a finding, never a silent re-pin. Boundary: a writer able to rewrite both this ledger and the carriers can satisfy it.

without_path_identity.note: M513/S03 UAT-4 pins agree with every surface. Preserved as an identity; never re-run and republished as fresh evidence.

document.license: Derived scholarly TEI of public arXiv PDFs. Source papers remain under their arXiv licenses (typically CC BY / CC BY-SA / CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 as declared on each abstract page). GROBID TEI is candidate parse evidence, not a republication of the PDF. Do not treat these files as graph-importable.

selection.identity_rule: An asset's arXiv identity is the first name walking from the PDF stem up through its ancestor directories whose trailing version suffix (`vN`, N >= 1, no leading zero) is stripped and whose remainder matches `^\d{4}\.\d{4,5}$`; so `<cat>/<id>/source/original.pdf` inherits `<id>` and an `<id>vN` directory contributes revision N. When one identity has several assets the lowest revision wins (versionless counts as revision 0), then the lexicographically smallest repo-relative path breaks the remaining tie.

baseline_denominator.basis_note: The full assigned population is 610. 531 documents carry an admitted non-zero evaluated population at the frozen structural profile; the 79 typed exclusions stay inside the denominator. Every ratio below is therefore already band-scoped: document coverage of the assigned population is 531/610 = 0.870492.

corpus.source_identity_rule: arXiv versionless identity is canonical; versioned assets are retained as provenance only when their checksum or declared revision is distinct.

native_route_corpus.source_identity_rule: Each row pins a repository-relative PDF by bare sha256 and its PDF-verified page count; a document's identity is its id plus that exact sha256, never the path alone. The three S02 corridor rows restate `corpus.documents` field-for-field; the nine holdout rows are already-committed arXiv identities whose PDF bytes and reference TEI exist in-tree.

selection.stratum_rule: An identity's stratum is its arXiv primary category mapped to the declared domains vocabulary: cs-* -> computer_science; math-* -> mathematics; cond-mat-*, physics-*, hep-*, quant-ph, astro-ph, gr-qc, nucl-* -> physics. Identities outside the closed domains vocabulary are ineligible.

native_route_threshold_reference.source_rule: Each route-corpus document id maps to exactly one reference TEI {path, sha256}. Holdout ids resolve to the acceptance-manifest measurable reference TEI for the matching article_id; corridor ids resolve to the preserved rich-profile TEI fixture `data/parse/regression_cases.yaml` binds. The block is not a second corpus: the document list stays authoritative in `native_route_corpus.documents`.

lanes.donor_identity_rule: Each lane receives the exact source_pdf and source_sha256 above; ordering is separate from extraction and every token remains conserved.

denominator.basis_note: The full assigned population is 610. 531 documents carry an admitted non-zero evaluated population at the frozen structural profile; the 79 typed exclusions stay inside the denominator. Every ratio below is therefore already band-scoped: document coverage of the assigned population is 531/610 = 0.870492.

refusal_semantics.definition: a refused document is an assigned identity whose bytes are present but which is neither in the probe's executed (per-document evaluated) population nor a typed exclusion; it stays inside the denominator
refusal_semantics.empty_reason: the frozen probe accounts for every one of the 610 assigned identities as executed or typed-excluded, so no document was refused and the refused set is explicitly empty

derivation.rule: assigned identities come from the holdout manifest; executed identities from the probe's per-document evaluated population (outcomes, matched by document_id); excluded identities from the probe's typed exceptions; a refused identity is assigned minus executed minus excluded; the projection is the document-id-sorted (document_id, disposition) list and the digest is sha256 over its compact UTF-8 JSON
derivation.projection_digest_rule: sha256 over json.dumps(projection, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) in UTF-8

population_census.boundary: consistency, not a tamper-evident attestation: a writer able to rewrite this block, the two frozen sources and the DATA rule can satisfy it; a scorecard that omits this block leaves the per-document half unverified while the aggregate partition stays governed by the domain's denominator and census checks

evidence.note: recomputed from evaluated_population.aggregate (admitted / source_population) and per-document conserved/source_population; the weakest document is recorded so the stratum is reproducible

micro recall is evaluated_population.class_parity.aggregate.native_capability_recall_micros / 1e6; the weakest family is the per-class conserved/source_population minimum across the 531 class profiles

measurements.reason_detail: production parses through java-grobid-http/0.9.1/processFulltextDocument at the structural profile; the native PDF-to-TEI route is not connected to a runner, so no java-free product measurement exists
no paired CPU measurement of the same workload exists; latency_accounting in the probe is bounded, not measured, and a wall-clock-only saving would not be a product measurement
the rollback pin is a rehearsed fallback target, not an executed product reliability measurement

authorization.note: D491 authorizes active non-commercial research only; it grants no release, distribution, graph write or import. The production retirement claim stays unmet until a named human records the release decision.

gate_run_history.note: M514-1lss2s/S01/T05 records the two governor architecture runs behind this baseline. The first run failed and its detailed output was not retained, so the cause is unresolved. A second run passed. A repeat is a fact, not a root cause.

runs.load: run alongside concurrent work; not a controlled serial run

selection.identity_rule: An asset's arXiv identity is the first name walking from the PDF stem up through its ancestor directories whose trailing version suffix (`vN`, N >= 1, no leading zero) is stripped and whose remainder matches `^\d{4}\.\d{4,5}$`; so `<cat>/<id>/source/original.pdf` inherits `<id>` and an `<id>vN` directory contributes revision N. baseline_denominator.basis_note: The full assigned population is 610. 531 documents carry an admitted non-zero evaluated population at the frozen structural profile; the 79 typed exclusions stay inside the denominator. Every ratio below is therefore already band-scoped: document coverage of the assigned population is 531/610 = 0.870492.

corpus.source_identity_rule: arXiv versionless identity is canonical; versioned assets are retained as provenance only when their checksum or declared revision is distinct.

native_route_corpus.source_identity_rule: Each row pins a repository-relative PDF by bare sha256 and its PDF-verified page count; a document's identity is its id plus that exact sha256, never the path alone. The three S02 corridor rows restate `corpus.documents` field-for-field; the nine holdout rows are already-committed arXiv identities whose PDF bytes and reference TEI exist in-tree.

selection.stratum_rule: An identity's stratum is its arXiv primary category mapped to the declared domains vocabulary: cs-* -> computer_science; math-* -> mathematics; cond-mat-*, physics-*, hep-*, quant-ph, astro-ph, gr-qc, nucl-* -> physics. Identities outside the closed domains vocabulary are ineligible.

native_route_threshold_reference.source_rule: Each route-corpus document id maps to exactly one reference TEI {path, sha256}. Holdout ids resolve to the acceptance-manifest measurable reference TEI for the matching article_id; corridor ids resolve to the preserved rich-profile TEI fixture `data/parse/regression_cases.yaml` binds. The block is not a second corpus: the document list stays authoritative in `native_route_corpus.documents`.

lanes.donor_identity_rule: Each lane receives the exact source_pdf and source_sha256 above; ordering is separate from extraction and every token remains conserved.

denominator.basis_note: The full assigned population is 610. 531 documents carry an admitted non-zero evaluated population at the frozen structural profile; the 79 typed exclusions stay inside the denominator. Every ratio below is therefore already band-scoped: document coverage of the assigned population is 531/610 = 0.870492.

refusal_semantics.definition: a refused document is an assigned identity whose bytes are present but which is neither in the probe's executed (per-document evaluated) population nor a typed exclusion; it stays inside the denominator
refusal_semantics.empty_reason: the frozen probe accounts for every one of the 610 assigned identities as executed or typed-excluded, so no document was refused and the refused set is explicitly empty

derivation.rule: assigned identities come from the holdout manifest; executed identities from the probe's per-document evaluated population (outcomes, matched by document_id); excluded identities from the probe's typed exceptions; a refused identity is assigned minus executed minus excluded; the projection is the document-id-sorted (document_id, disposition) list and the digest is sha256 over its compact UTF-8 JSON
derivation.projection_digest_rule: sha256 over json.dumps(projection, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) in UTF-8

population_census.boundary: consistency, not a tamper-evident attestation: a writer able to rewrite this block, the two frozen sources and the DATA rule can satisfy it; a scorecard that omits this block leaves the per-document half unverified while the aggregate partition stays governed by the domain's denominator and census checks

evidence.note: recomputed from evaluated_population.aggregate (admitted / source_population) and per-document conserved/source_population; the weakest document is recorded so the stratum is reproducible

micro recall is evaluated_population.class_parity.aggregate.native_capability_recall_micros / 1e6; the weakest family is the per-class conserved/source_population minimum across the 531 class profiles

measurements.reason_detail: production parses through java-grobid-http/0.9.1/processFulltextDocument at the structural profile; the native PDF-to-TEI route is not connected to a runner, so no java-free product measurement exists
no paired CPU measurement of the same workload exists; latency_accounting in the probe is bounded, not measured, and a wall-clock-only saving would not be a product measurement
the rollback pin is a rehearsed fallback target, not an executed product reliability measurement

authorization.note: D491 authorizes active non-commercial research only; it grants no release, distribution, graph write or import. The production retirement claim stays unmet until a named human records the release decision.

gate_run_history.note: M514-1lss2s/S01/T05 records the two governor architecture runs behind this baseline. The first run failed and its detailed output was not retained, so the cause is unresolved. A second run passed. A repeat is a fact, not a root cause.

runs.load: run alongside concurrent work; not a controlled serial run
serial re-run without concurrent cargo or python load

hypothesis.statement: the first failure may have been an environment-sensitive interaction in the da-parse test binary rather than a source regression; the bind-then-drop shape of http_backend_surfaces_transport_outage_as_unavailable is one candidate
hypothesis.evidence_from_the_failed_run: none: the gate printed only the last five stderr lines and did not record the failing test or its output
hypothesis.disconfirming_evidence: an isolated re-run of the same step and of backend_contract reported zero failures
cannot_conclude: no root cause is established
no claim that a flake was eliminated
no claim that no regression occurred

diagnostics_change.what: the architecture gate now persists the full stdout and stderr of every failing step and extracts the libtest failing-test names, so the next failure identifies itself

historical_guard_pins.note: sha256 of the M513 carriers this slice must not touch. Recomputed by scripts/tests/test_absorption_progress_baseline.py; a changed byte here is a finding, never a silent re-pin. Boundary: a writer able to rewrite both this ledger and the carriers can satisfy it.

without_path_identity.note: M513/S03 UAT-4 pins agree with every surface. Preserved as an identity; never re-run and republished as fresh evidence.

document.license: Derived scholarly TEI of public arXiv PDFs. Source papers remain under their arXiv licenses (typically CC BY / CC BY-SA / CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 as declared on each abstract page). GROBID TEI is candidate parse evidence, not a republication of the PDF. Do not treat these files as graph-importable.

selection.identity_rule: An asset's arXiv identity is the first name walking from the PDF stem up through its ancestor directories whose trailing version suffix (`vN`, N >= 1, no leading zero) is stripped and whose remainder matches `^\d{4}\.\d{4,5}$`; so `<cat>/<id>/source/original.pdf` inherits `<id>` and an `<id>vN` directory contributes revision N. When one identity has several assets the lowest revision wins (versionless counts as revision 0), then the lexicographically smallest repo-relative path breaks the remaining tie.
